violations.rule: what_now: only what was done and that the team knows, said humanly (warm, polite); the answer to 'what do I do now' restates the ticket and ends on a cold limit line instead of a human word
violations.quote: זה הדבר היחיד שאני יכול לעשות מכאן.

violations.rule: A finished matter ends with an offer to help with anything else; the ticket message closes on a question about the situation, the what-now reply on a full stop, and no offer is made anywhere
violations.quote: פתחתי לך קריאה דחופה, מספר 255-1490-26, והצוות כבר יודע על המים בחדר המדרגות. זה הדבר היחיד שאני יכול לעשות מכאן.

X.notes: The emergency path is right: team note before the first reply, שלום and the name once, one building-and-apartment question, urgent ticket in the resident's words reported with its number, no emoji, advice, numbers or promise, warm goodbye with no question. The weak spot is the what-now reply. The team note's own added wording is not the ticket and is not counted.
